name: Insight
description: Pre-trade decision-input integrity for onchain AI agents: is the price trustworthy? Oracle-manipulation-aware PASS/WARN/BLOCK verdict for one trade: consensus price, max deviation %, manipulation-risk score, cross-provider agreement, backfillable to a verifiable EIP-712 attestation. Pay-per-call: $0.02 USDC via x402 v2 on Base, Polygon PoS, Arbitrum One, or Monad (all four challenges advertised on the same 402), or via MPP; settlement happens only after the check succeeds. Endpoint is MCP over Streamable HTTP.

extensions.description: Supports payments using the x402 protocol for on-chain settlement. Every paid call returns an HTTP 402 challenge advertising USDC acceptance on eip155:8453 (Base), eip155:137 (Polygon), eip155:42161 (Arbitrum One), eip155:143 (Monad) and Solana devnet.

skills.name: Pre-trade safety check
skills.description: Oracle-manipulation-aware PASS/WARN/BLOCK verdict for a single trade (asset, chainId, action, tradeAmountUsd). Returns consensus price, max deviation %, manipulation-risk score and provider quorum; optionally a verifiable EIP-712 attestation. $0.02 USDC via x402 v2 (Base, Polygon, Arbitrum One, or Monad) or MPP, settled only after success.
examples: Before my agent swaps USDC for ETH on Base, tell it whether the price feed it just read is currently trustworthy
My trading agent reads prices from a single aggregator — check them against 10 independent providers and sign the verdict
Check whether swapping 1000 USD of ETH on mainnet is exposed to oracle manipulation
Get a manipulation-risk verdict before executing a trade
